method: Actual listed images opened with view_image; no app-driving operations by this reviewer. State facts are separated from visual observations.

observations: All eight island tabs and footer actions remain readable with a neutral dark composer. The green accents are selected Agent/actions, not a green text-field fill.
Whitespace submission leaves the blank composer visible. The two-line first/second draft fits without clipping, and the submitted bubble preserves those two lines above the cleared composer.
The final-scene sidebar has one readable Scene card and New scene action; cube, main toolbar and viewport are intact.

Connect engine is absent in the first open-composer capture, then visible in all later composer captures. The remaining layout is stable and readable; these stills do not establish why the initial control was absent.
Both standalone Moodboard and View3D drawer render the selected checkerboard card, full filename, nonoverlapping Rename/Preview/Export action row, selection border and plus connector clearly.
All eight title crops preserve the complete readable reference.png or outputroom.png filename across the four zoom states; no clipped glyphs or disproportionate title scaling is visible.

All six hovered tooltips are actually present in the framebuffer captures. Each has one heading and one complete readable description. Rename, Preview and Export text fits in both hosts, with no duplicated help or clipping.
The fixture PNG itself is a blue-grey and white checkerboard.

limitations: Framebuffer island captures do not establish OS-composited alpha or blur.
Native composer crop has a uniform dark backdrop, so it proves visible controls and neutral color but is not a quantitative translucency probe.
Only listed images were visually reviewed; no blanket UI certification is implied.
Framebuffer capture does not prove OS-composited translucency or background blur.
The Thinking bubble and submitted text demonstrate local UI state only; no provider response or backend completion is claimed.
Single-scene deletion protection is established by state, since the screenshot does not show a delete menu.
diagnostics: Initial picker, BYOK predicate, mask capture, steer pointer-lifetime and Moodboard failures are retained and distinguished from their corrected passing runs in the full report.
